headline: Peak XV and Portsmouth Tech offload stakes in Awfis and Anthem Biosciences
hook: Private equity firms exit two portfolio companies
summary: Peak XV Partners has sold a 2.68% stake in co-working space provider Awfis Space Solutions. Simultaneously, Portsmouth Tech has divested shares in Anthem Biosciences. These transactions represent secondary market sales by institutional investors. Retail investors should note that such stake sales often lead to short-term supply pressure on the stock price.
why_it_matters: Increased selling pressure may temporarily weigh on share prices.
winners_losers: Buyers gain / Existing shareholders face supply pressure

headline: Portsmouth Technologies sells 30 lakh shares of Anthem Biosciences for Rs 250 crore in a block deal
hook: Portsmouth exits thirty lakh shares at a loss
summary: Portsmouth Technologies LLC sold 30 lakh shares of Anthem Biosciences at Rs 833 per share on October 9, totaling Rs 249.90 crore. This transaction significantly reduces Portsmouth's stake in the company. The block deal comes as Anthem Biosciences recently reported a decline in both total income and profit after tax for the first quarter of FY27. Indian retail investors should note this major shareholder exit amid softening financial performance.
why_it_matters: Large shareholder exit adds pressure to struggling stock
